responsibility: Declares diagnostics::text_sink, the concrete sink subclass for traditional text output. The class combines sink callbacks with text-specific helpers for prefixes, include-stack reporting, note emission, path printing, location formatting, source-printing option management, and nested-diagnostic display, and also carries the saved output-buffer state needed to participate in diagnostics::buffer buffering semantics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the text_sink class, its buffering-related state, configuration flags, and helper methods for traditional text diagnostics output. Unlike text-sink.cc, it exposes the sink's public/protected interface and stored state rather than the detailed emission and buffering logic.
